sample_unit: clinicians (physicians and advanced practice providers) completing pre and post surveys

links.outcome: Clinician burnout and professional fulfillment measured with the Stanford PFI before and after ambient AI scribe use
links.effect: Median burnout score fell from 4.16 to 3.16 (p=0.005); burnout rate fell from 69% to 43%; work exhaustion unchanged; fulfillment 6.1 vs 6.5 (p=0.10, non-significant).
links.quote: Results showed a significant reduction in burnout scores, with the median burnout score improving from 4.16 to 3.16 (p=0.005), with validated Stanford PFI cutoff for overall burnout 3.33.

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world deployment of commercial ambient AI documentation software on clinician burnout and professional fulfillment using a pre-post study design.
